messages.routeAsk: Which workstream do you mean? Candidates: {candidates}
messages.routeQuestion: Which scope do you want to work on: {candidates}?
messages.routeMissingWorkstream: {sub} has no workstream for "{wanted}". Available: {available}. Do you want to create a new one (needs confirmation) or use an existing one?
messages.routeMissingFile: The file of {files} does not exist: should the index be fixed or the workstream created?
messages.routeOverview: no scope named and several projects: overview
messages.itemDeclaredDoneNoCommit: Declared done without any commit citing it: cannot be verified, check the "Done when" condition.
messages.itemUnmerged: Commits on branches not merged into HEAD ({branches}): the work may already be done there. Check that branch (git show <branch>:<file>) before redoing it.
messages.itemClosedWithCommits: No longer in the backlog and commits cite it: closed with evidence.
messages.itemNothingFound: Neither in the backlog nor in any commit.
messages.itemOverdue: {id} is overdue ({days} days past its date)
messages.checkDuplicateId: ID {id} is used more than once in the workspace: {files}
messages.checkStaleNext: "Next" item {id} is neither an open item nor a workstream
messages.checkMissingRef: {id} refers to {ref}, which does not exist
messages.checkStale: {id} has been open for {days} days: keep, postpone with {from}:, or remove
messages.checkMissingFile: Workstream {id} points to a missing file: {file}
messages.checkDeclaredDone: {id} is checked off: verify the evidence and remove it
messages.checkDanglingLink: {id} cites {ref}, which is no longer in the backlog (closed or nonexistent)
messages.checkAmbiguousLink: {id} cites {ref}, which exists in several projects: {matches}. Qualify it with project:ID.
messages.checkMissingIndex: Project has no index file {file}: run /backlog init
messages.overviewNoMarkers: Overview file {file} has no generated-block markers: adding them needs the user's confirmation.
messages.overviewStale: The generated block of {file} is out of date: run overview --write.

panel.title: Backlog
panel.inProgress: In progress: {id}. Run /backlog:session to resume or close it.
panel.orphanProposal: {id} was left unfinished: resume or free it
panel.opened: {n} open items: pick in the pane.
panel.openedFor: {n} open items ({filter}): pick in the pane.
panel.unblockTitle: Unblock first · {n} items block other work
panel.noCommit: No commit: the change stays in the working tree.
panel.gone: {id} is no longer in the backlog.
panel.unmergedLine: Already touched on a branch not merged here: {commits}
panel.promptNoDoneWhen: This item has no "Done when" criterion: propose one and ask me to confirm it before you start.
panel.promptParts: Parts ([x] are already done, resume from the open ones):
panel.promptCycle: Warning: it is part of a dependency cycle ({chain}); tell me before you start.
panel.promptUnmerged: Warning: commits that cite the item sit on branches not merged into the current one ({commits}). Before working, check what is already done there (`git show {branch}:{file}`, `git show --stat <hash>`) and tell me: it should be merged, not redone.
panel.promptRules: Do not read other backlogs: open only the files the item cites and that you really need. If it is a decision, propose the options and ask me. If the item has several independent parts and no Parts yet, add them under the item as `- [ ] part` before starting; mark each finished part `[x]` in the same commit as its code.
panel.promptIndexes: The index files above its file ({files}): open them only to update them when the item closes or its status or next step changes.
panel.promptRemove: When the work is verified, remove the item from `{file}`.
panel.lockedNote: In progress in another session: it cannot be taken here until that session closes or releases it.
panel.guardRead: backlog: item {ref} is active and its prompt already carries it, so no other backlogs ({file}). Only these stay open: {allowed}. If another backlog is really needed, ask the user.
panel.guardCheck: backlog check after editing {file}: {n} new issue(s): {issues}
panel.guardCommit: backlog: the commit message does not cite {ref}. Item IDs go in the commit message: that is how closing and history are traced.
